rows.grounds: repeated nominative singular neuter of satya

items.question: Is merely seeing the former teacher sufficient to constitute true Kula vision?
premises: Kula vision requires more than sight
items.inference: mere darśana of the former is insufficient; true recognition must be firmly established
uncertainties: the referent of 'former' is not specified in this verse
items.plain_english: Seeing the former is not truly truth; truth is well established.
